item.title: Microsoft BitLocker – YellowKey zero-day exploit
item.description:
📝 (Image credit: Future)To say that this is dangerous is an understatement. Eclipse notes that using a full TPM-and-PIN setup doesn't help, as apparently, they have a variant for that scenario that they haven't published a PoC for. BlueHammer has already been patched, and Chaotic claims that Microsoft silently patched RedSun, but there's no official word on that either.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/cyber-security/microsoft-bitlocker-protected-drives-can-now-be-opened-with-just-some-files-on-a-usb-stick-yellowkey-zero-day-exploit-demonstrates-an-apparent-backdoor
